newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian PM invited to China.
newsitem.headline: Belgian PM invited to China.

text.p: Chinese Prime Minister Li Peng has invited Belgian counterpart Jean-Luc Dehaene to visit China in a bid to strengthen economic relations between Brussels and Beijing, Belga news agency reported on Sunday.
The invitation was forwarded during a brief meeting on the margins of the United Nations food summit in Rome. The date has yet to be set.

Li and Dehaene met last March during the 25-nation European Union-Asia summit in Bangkok and both then expressed an interest in deepening their countries' economic relations, including Belgian investments in China.
